title: Safe at the Margins: A General Approach to Safety Alignment in Low-Resource English Languages – A Singlish Case Study

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model safety, toxicity reduction, and over-refusal rates using a custom dataset of Singlish prompts (SGToxicityPrompts) to test alignment effectively in a low-resource English creole context compared to standard English-centric alignment.

Evaluating cross-domain toxicity generalization by measuring the model's toxicity rate on the TOXIGEN dataset, which contains machine-generated toxic and benign statements targeting 13 minority groups, using a fine-tuned HateBert classifier.
